environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2. The ALB has three listener rules evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 5: forward /health to target group unconditionally; (2) Priority 10: a rule matching path pattern /api/* with conditions that invoke an associated WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL (regional scope) contains two rule groups: first, a custom rule group with a RegexPatternSet-based rule that inspects SingleQueryArgument 'q' against pattern `(?i)('|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|update\s|delete\s|drop\s|exec\s|0x[0-9a-f])` with action BLOCK and priority 1; second, the AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 2 with all rules in BLOCK mode and sensitivity level HIGH. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to a CloudWatch log group with a metric filter that triggers an alarm on any WAF BLOCK action, but this is monitoring-only and does not affect request processing.

config.network: Private subnet, no direct internet access to container
config.monitoring: CloudWatch metric filter on WAF BLOCK events
